**Enum** in the `Latiprimere.Ipp` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Ipp](/docs/reference/#latiprimereipp) package.

```csharp
public enum IppRasterFormat
```

The raster formats Latiprimere can render a PDF into for a printer that can't take PDF, for [IppNetworkOptions.RasterFormats](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/ippnetworkoptions/#rasterformats).

## Values

- **`PwgRaster`** (`0`): PWG raster (`image/pwg-raster`), which IPP Everywhere printers take.
- **`AppleRaster`** (`1`): Apple raster (`image/urf`), which AirPrint printers take.
- **`Pclm`** (`2`): PCLm (`application/PCLm`), which Mopria printers take: each page as image strips in a PDF.
